subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold for secrets-audit check-mode automation?
rationale: The code is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether info-level secrets findings may be ignored by automation is a security/product policy choice.

options.title: Require secops sponsorship first
options.body: Hold the PR until a secrets/security owner explicitly accepts the public threshold or asks for a narrower variant.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the opt-in threshold as-is because plain `--check` keeps the existing default and the PR includes docs, tests, and terminal proof.

options.title: Close or narrow
options.body: Close this direction for now or request a smaller policy such as limiting threshold behavior to selected finding classes.

recommendation.title: Require secops sponsorship first
recommendation.body: Hold the PR until a secrets/security owner explicitly accepts the public threshold or asks for a narrower variant.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history connection to the secrets audit CLI and its security-adjacent behavior.
